description: Real PyGoat findings from the ASVA pipeline, hardcoded for the RAG demo and evaluation. Built by tools/build_fixture.py from ASVA's triage batches (normalised + triaged Snyk findings) plus each rule's CWE ids from the Snyk SARIF files ('sarif_cwes'). Nothing reads the asva folder at runtime.

findings.title: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection
findings.summary: Unsanitized user input from the HTTP request body flows into xml.dom.pulldom.parseString, with external entities being enabled. This introduces the risk of XML External Entity Injection (XXE) attacks, which can lead to disclosure of confidential data, Denial of Service (DOS), Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and other threats.
